 Mr. Saidur Rahaman
 ... for the respondent Nos. 1 to 4/claimants
In Fmat(Mv) 50 of 2024 Mr. Saidur Rahaman ... for the appellants/claimants In Fmat(Mv) 4 of
2024 Mr. Rajesh Singh ... for the respondent No.1/insurance co.
In FMAT(MV) 4 of 2024 In RE: CAN 1 of 2024 The affidavit of service filed in Court today be kept on record.
The learned advocates representing the appellant/insurance company as well as respondent No.1 to 4/claimants are present.
The application being CAN 1 of 2024 under Section 5 of the limitation Act has been taken up for hearing.
From the record it reveals that there is a delay of 51 days.
Considering the averments made in the CAN application being 1 of 2024 and in view of the beneficial legislative intent the delay of 51 days in filing the instant case is condoned.
The application being CAN 1 of 2024 is allowed.
The Department is directed to register the appeal.
Re: CAN 2 of 2024

As per the order of this Court dated 11.03.2024 the Insurance Company had deposited the entire awarded compensation before the office of the learned Registrar General, High Court at Calcutta vide OD Challan No. 155 dated 16.04.2024.
Let the said challan be kept on record.
